title: Prior art for deterministic controls around probabilistic agents
objective: Investigate prior art and counterexamples without claiming first use or overstating novelty.
audience: Technical operator and local implementation agents
context: Sanitized demonstration fixture. No actual client data, production repository or account state is represented.

frozen: Preserve the stated scope and output IDs.
Clearly distinguish performed work from suggested steps.
exclusions: Do not use Work or Codex
implementation_freedom: Choose concise explanatory wording unless exact text is supplied.

authorization.approval_basis: Synthetic/public example content authored for this release; approval applies only to these fixture bytes.

questions: What published architectures separate probabilistic judgment from deterministic permission and validation controls?
Which sources use equivalent terminology and how close is the meaning?
Where does compiling repeated resolutions into rules fail or need exceptions?
payload.date_window: Focus on 2024 through 2026-09-17; include older foundational prior art when directly relevant.

source_policy.access_limits: Report inaccessible sources; do not imply complete coverage

counterevidence: Cases where apparent determinism does not enforce policy
output_structure: Earliest credible use found, not proven priority
payload.citation_contract: Exact URLs, source IDs, publication/update/retrieval dates, evidence locators

acceptance: Label gaps, assumptions and tests not run.
